title: A vision-language foundation model for precision oncology

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A vision-language foundation model for precision oncology》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Clinical decision-making is driven by multimodal data, including clinical notes and pathological characteristics.

evidence.text: Clinical decision-making is driven by multimodal data, including clinical notes and pathological characteristics.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A vision-language foundation model for precision oncology》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】MUSK was pretrained on 50 million pathology images from 11,577 patients and one billion pathology-related text tokens using unified masked modelling.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】With minimal or no further training, MUSK was tested in a wide range of applications and demonstrated superior performance across 23 patch-level and slide-level benchmarks, including image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval, visual question answering, image classification and molecular biomarker prediction.

evidence.text: MUSK was pretrained on 50 million pathology images from 11,577 patients and one billion pathology-related text tokens using unified masked modelling.

With minimal or no further training, MUSK was tested in a wide range of applications and demonstrated superior performance across 23 patch-level and slide-level benchmarks, including image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval, visual question answering, image classification and molecular biomarker prediction.
